If you're not using Cache Components, see the [Caching and Revalidating (Previous Model)](/docs/app/guides/caching-without-cache-components) guide. Caching is a technique for storing the result of data fetching and other computations so that future requests for the same data can be served faster, without doing the work again. ## Enabling Cache Components New App Router apps created with the recommended [`create-next-app`](/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app) defaults already have Cache Components and Partial Prefetching enabled. Leaving it unset logs a warning, because the first release of Cache Components did not include Partial Prefetching. Set it to `false` only while [migrating an app that adopted Cache Components before Partial Prefetching](/docs/app/guides/adopting-partial-prefetching).
